line: okay so much is going on. work is insane, we just did a reorg and my team doubled and honestly i love it? like i'm good at it. my mom keeps calling about thanksgiving which is months away, classic her. also i started running again, 5ks, my knees hate me. and my best friend just moved to lisbon which is so cool for her. it's a lot but it's fine, i thrive on a lot.

the reorg? oh it's fine, i mean my old manager left, which, whatever. she hired me originally. she was kind of my person there? but the new structure makes sense on paper. anyway the running is mostly so i have an hour where nobody can schedule me. my calendar is wall to wall. i did the math, i have eleven hours of meetings on tuesdays. eleven! anyway. what else. the lisbon thing. we used to get dinner every thursday for like six years and now it's a whatsapp thread.

ha, yeah everyone keeps saying congratulations about the team thing. and i keep doing this thing where i say thank you and then immediately talk about something else. i don't know why i do that. anyway my point is things are objectively great. objectively.
...huh. okay. yeah. the people keep leaving thing. i hadn't put it like that.
